text: Asthenopia [Gr. a + sqenoV , strength, + wy , eye]: Ger. Asthenopia ; Fr. asthénopie ; Ital. astenopia . A visual weakness due to the susceptibility to fatigue of the muscular mechanism concerned in the accommodation or in the general movements of the eyes. It may result from special strain or weakness in the accommodation mechanism or in the ocular muscles, or as a system of more general disorder. Cf. VISION (defects of). A retinal asthenopia is also spoken of. See Norris and Oliver, Syst . Dis . Eye (1900), iv; Clarke, Eye Strain (1892). ( J.J .)
